description: Read a text, CSV, JSON, log, .xlsx, .docx, or text-based PDF file with Indonesian personal data replaced by stable placeholders ([NIK_1], [PHONE_2], [RELIGION_1] …). The same value always gets the same placeholder in this session, so joins, counts, grouping and deduplication still work. Real values never leave the user's machine. Spreadsheets come back as CSV, one block per sheet; Word documents as their text plus each table as CSV; PDFs one block per page.
name: read_file_masked
title: Read a file with personal data masked
